Thanks again for your time today. Per our demo (great questions from the team), I dropped the recording and the slide deck below so your engineers and product folks can review at their own pace.

Attachments: [meridian-demo.mp4 (video, 42MB)], [meridian-slides.pdf (PDF, 3.6MB)]

If it’s useful, I can hold a focused 10-minute AMA (no slides) to answer any integration or compliance questions — I find short syncs are the quickest way to unblock engineering. If that works, here’s a short calendar pick: https://calendar.redwood.com/axm/15min
